response.sql:
WITH order_fills AS (
  SELECT
    oe.ordersmark,
    o.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions AS oe
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.timespan
),
time_in_force_means AS (
  SELECT timespan, AVG(avg_fill) AS mean_avg_fill
  FROM order_fills
  GROUP BY timespan
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT
    f.ordersmark,
    f.timespan,
    f.avg_fill,
    m.mean_avg_fill,
    f.avg_fill - m.mean_avg_fill AS excess_over_mean,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY f.timespan
      ORDER BY f.avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS fill_rank
  FROM order_fills AS f
  JOIN time_in_force_means AS m
    ON f.timespan IS m.timespan
  WHERE f.avg_fill > m.mean_avg_fill
)
SELECT
  ordersmark,
  timespan,
  avg_fill,
  excess_over_mean,
  fill_rank
FROM ranked_orders
WHERE fill_rank <= 3
ORDER BY timespan, fill_rank, ordersmark;

assumptions.assumption: Each order is identified by its recordvault/ordersmark value, so executions for that value are averaged together; the mean for each time in force gives each such order equal weight. Orders without a matched execution are excluded.
